name: workflow
description: Landing gates, capture, the ticket chain and role discipline: /gemini (independent second-opinion review, challenge, consult, judge), /springclean (adversarial taste-and-proportion panel), /spec-sharpen (multi-pass requirements review until signable, a blind lens that never sees the draft, five ranked findings per lens, a ready check and a plain explanation before signing, and process evals that rerun it on past misses, leaving an append-only comment trail so a deferred or killed finding stays reviewable), /build and /digest (the cheap paths across the coordinator/builder/scout boundary, with a comment pass on every build), /test-writing (a separate agent writes a change's tests, one per rule and spent top-down on a risk ladder, or audits a branch's tests keep / merge / cut / gap, with a script that prints the size split, test-to-code ratio and diff coverage a PR description quotes, a description that opens with four plain sections a non-developer reviewer can follow), /issue (classified, cross-linked GitHub issue capture, and escapes filed with the step that should have caught them, counted monthly), /intake and /pickup (a request becomes an evidence-cited draft ticket with its duplicates and regressions already found, a human signs it, a run whose labels and poll query are proved usable before it polls carries it through a bounded reviewer loop to a PR under a per-route autonomy dial, recording each step as a comment on the ticket), /worktree (per-ticket isolation with conflicts detected and never resolved), /coordinate (one chat owns a multi-chat release: a session-state file that survives compaction, owner chats told before their worktrees are touched, their green verified rather than relayed, the unmerged combination tested on staging, and the human handed only their own steps), /project-setup (seed into any repo the conventions, the role-fence hook, the pickup policy, the testing rule, an optional Stop-hook completion check that lets the assistant wait on work it launched, and a read-only tools check that names which credential is missing, malformed or rejected), plus the role-to-model agents (explorer scouts cheap, builder writes the code, reviewer sits on landing-gate panels, briefed with the neighbouring rules a change could contradict)
